 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Nafisuzzoha, Advocate  For the State : Ms/Mrs. Rina Sinha, Addl Public Prosecu  for opposite party no.2 Mr Ashif Kalim, Advocate

== 
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 7 19-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420/323 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. By filing supplementary affidavit, it is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that alleged amount claimed by opposite party no.2 is false and concocted.

However, he admits that he has taken from informant/opposite party no.2 Rs.70,000/- which he is ready to refund in three installments within six months to opposite party no.2 without prejudice to his right and contention.
4. Considering the facts of the case, nature of accusation against the petitioner, let the petitioner,
above named, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from today shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Judicial Magistrate, 1st class, Araria Patna High Court CR. MISC.

sentences.text: (i) At the time of furnishing bail bond Rs. 35,000/ - shall be deposited in the Court below in the name of O.P. No.2.
(ii) Rest amount of Rs. 35,000/- shall be deposited in equal installments within six months in the name of O.P. No.2 within two months.
(iii) If the petitioner fails to comply with the aforesaid direction of this court, the court below shall be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioner.
5. It is made clear that without going into the merit of the case, the aforesaid order has been passed only for the purpose of grant of bail.
